concept: a tax collector's ledger bound in flayed skin that reads a debtor's name aloud and takes what is owed from their flesh
a mountain goat with antlers of living ice that butts climbers off the ledge and freezes the handholds behind them
a swamp heron that spears frogs and men alike, then wades backward into the reeds where nothing can follow
a foundry overseer welded into his own furnace-suit who brands deserters and cannot stop walking
a mourning veil that settles over a sleeper's face and speaks with the dead until the sleeper stops breathing
a siege ram given a bull's temper, iron-shod, that will not stop until the gate or itself is splinters
a cellar rat-king grown wise on stolen spellbooks, whose tails knot around anyone who reads over its shoulder
a hanged judge whose noose still tightens around the guilty from a hundred feet away
a bridge troll who took a toll in teeth for a century and now wears them all
